description: The sequence names of twk_dev (lib/src/decode.dart) and of the VS Code extension (core/sequences.ts, seqlog.ts): reads are bytes cut into tokens and named, logs are bytes into entries and frames. Each side is held to it.

reads.name: text and controls
reads.description: a run of text; each control character one token

tokens.name: REP repeat the last character 2 times
ED erase the screen to the end
ED erase the screen to the end
ED erase the screen to the start
ED erase the screen and the scrollback
EL erase the line to the end
DECSED erase the screen to the end, keeping protected cells
DECSEL erase the line all, keeping protected cells

reads.name: sgr
reads.description: attributes, colours in all their forms

tokens.name: SGR fg bright black, bg bright white
SGR double underline, not bold or dim, overline, not overlined, underline colour default
DECRQM query: ANSI mode 12 local echo off
DECSTBM scrolling region rows 2 to the bottom
XTVERSION query: the terminal name and version
XTWINOPS resize to undefined rows, undefined columns
XTWINOPS query: the window size in pixels
XTWINOPS query: a cell size in pixels
XTWINOPS query: the size in cells

reads.name: utf-8 split
reads.description: the two bytes of an e acute cut between reads

reads.name: csi split
reads.description: a CSI cut between reads waits for the rest

reads.name: esc split
reads.description: ESC at the end of a read waits

reads.name: osc split
reads.description: an OSC cut in its body

reads.name: st split
reads.description: a DCS cut between ESC and its backslash

reads.name: unfinished
reads.description: what never ends is left waiting

reads.name: three reads
reads.description: a CSI over three reads

reads.name: invalid utf-8
reads.description: a byte that is no UTF-8 is U+FFFD

reads.name: typed text
reads.description: one character is a key

reads.name: typed string
reads.description: several characters at once were typed or pasted

reads.name: controls
reads.description: Enter

reads.name: lone escape
reads.description: an ESC that ends a read is the Escape key

reads.name: alt key
reads.description: ESC and a key

reads.name: alt O
reads.description: ESC O at the end of a read is Alt+O

reads.name: esc bracket
reads.description: ESC [ at the end of a read

tokens.name: mouse left press at column 10, row 5
mouse left release at column 10, row 5
mouse right press at column 3, row 4
mouse none moved at column 1, row 1
mouse wheel up at column 7, row 8
mouse wheel down at column 7, row 8
mouse Shift+wheel up at column 1, row 2
mouse Ctrl+left press at column 2, row 2
mouse left moved at column 5, row 5
mouse Alt+middle release at column 1, row 1

reads.name: mouse x10
reads.description: CSI M and three bytes

tokens.name: mouse (X10) left press at column 10, row 5
mouse (X10) left moved at column 8, row 9

reads.name: mouse x10 cut
reads.description: CSI M without its three bytes is a CSI

tokens.name: CPR answer: the cursor at row 24, column 80
CPR answer: the cursor at row 5, column 1
DECRPM answer: mode 2026 synchronized output reset
DECRPM answer: mode 2004 bracketed paste set
DECRPM answer: mode 1049 alternate screen, cursor saved not recognised

reads.name: alt multibyte key
reads.description: Alt and a character of two bytes is one key

reads.name: esc multibyte
reads.description: ESC and a character of two bytes: its final is the whole character

reads.name: esc multibyte split
reads.description: the character cut between reads: the ESC waits for it

reads.name: esc esc
reads.description: ESC does not end an ESC: the first is alone, the second begins a CSI

reads.name: alt escape
reads.description: a doubled ESC from the terminal is Escape with Alt

reads.name: alt cursor keys
reads.description: ESC before a CSI or an SS3 from the terminal is that key with Alt

reads.name: alt tilde key with a control inside
reads.description: a control inside the CSI is a key press of its own

reads.name: esc esc text
reads.description: ESC ESC and a letter: Escape, then Alt+letter

reads.name: alt f3 is no position
reads.description: CSI 1;5 R after an ESC is a key whatever was asked

reads.name: decxcpr answer
reads.description: CSI ? row ; column R answers CSI ? 6 n

tokens.name: DECXCPR answer: the cursor at row 5, column 7

reads.name: alt control keys
reads.description: Alt with Enter, Tab, Backspace, Ctrl+X and Ctrl+Space are named, not printed

reads.name: csi without a final
reads.description: a byte that cannot end a CSI ends it as invalid and is read afresh

reads.name: csi with a control inside
reads.description: a C0 control inside a CSI is executed where it is and the CSI goes on

reads.name: csi with a control among its parameters
reads.description: LF between parameters is executed, the CSI keeps all of them

reads.name: csi with a backspace inside
reads.description: BS before the final

reads.name: csi with a control split
reads.description: the control is shown once although the CSI waits for the next read

reads.name: csi cancelled by can
reads.description: CAN ends a CSI as invalid

reads.name: csi cancelled by sub
reads.description: SUB ends a CSI as invalid

reads.name: character cut before an escape
reads.description: the lead bytes of a cut character are text of their own when an escape follows, not lost

reads.name: character cut before a control
reads.description: and when a control character follows

reads.name: f3 or a position
reads.description: CSI 1;5 R by bytes alone is the F3 key with Ctrl, or the cursor on row 1 at column 5: the name says it cannot tell

tokens.name: key Ctrl+F3, or a CPR answer: the cursor at row 1, column 5

reads.name: character cut by a control
reads.description: the first byte of a character before a control character is not completed by the text after it

reads.name: string split many times
reads.description: a string cut into many reads is one token once it ends

logs.name: a frame
logs.description: a synchronized update is one entry with its entries below it

entries.name: frame 1: 2 text, 2 SGR, 1 DECSET, 1 ED, 1 CUP, 1 CR

logs.name: a frame cut between reads
logs.description: the entry is made once the update ends, at the time it began

entries.name: frame 1: 1 DECSET, 1 CUP, 1 text, 1 DECRST, 50 ms

logs.name: input, output and notes
logs.description: both ways and the session in the order they came

entries.name: mouse left press at column 1, row 1

logs.name: two frames and a summary
logs.description: a summary counts the first word of each name, the most first, equal counts in the order seen

entries.name: frame 1: 3 EL, 2 CUP, 2 SGR, 2 text, 1 DECSET, 1 DECRST

children.name: EL erase the line to the end
EL erase the line to the end

logs.name: an update that never ends
logs.description: its entries wait: no entry is made

logs.name: an update not closed
logs.description: at the end of the traffic an open update is a frame that says so

entries.name: frame 1: 1 DECSET, 1 CUP, 1 text, 3 ms, not closed

logs.name: output cut short
logs.description: what the app wrote unfinished is a note at the end

logs.name: a stray end of an update
logs.description: a reset with no update open is noted, and the next update is a frame whole

entries.name: no synchronized update is open: CSI ? 2026 l ignored

logs.name: a position asked
logs.description: CSI 1;5 R after a cursor position query is its answer, once; then it is F3

entries.name: CPR answer: the cursor at row 1, column 5

logs.name: a position given up
logs.description: a key typed after the query gives it up: CSI 1;5 R is F3

logs.name: a decxcpr asked
logs.description: CSI ? 6 n is answered by CSI ? r;c R, once; then CSI 1;5 R is F3

entries.name: DECXCPR answer: the cursor at row 5, column 7
